prompt: In one to three minutes, in English: why inVision U, and one time you led other people — what you did, and what came of it.

segments.text: I want to study at inVision U because I like building things that other people actually use, and I want to learn to do it at a bigger scale.
Last spring our school robotics team had three weeks left before the regional competition and the robot still could not climb the ramp.
I split the team into two groups, one on the drive system and one on the software, and we met every evening for fifteen minutes to check progress.
When the new motor arrived broken, I called the supplier myself and we borrowed a motor from another school until the replacement came.
We finished fourth out of eighteen teams. It was not first, but the robot climbed the ramp every time, and two younger students joined the team after that.
What I learned is that a clear plan with short check-ins works better than long meetings, and that is how I would like to work at inVision U.
